notes.title: Thank You for the Release, Patch Update, and Future Plans
notes.content:
To all players,
This is MYU, director of Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo.

On Wednesday, September 17, we successfully released the game. Two days have now passed since launch, and many people have already played it and shared their impressions and reactions on social media and other platforms. It finally feels real that the game has launched, and I am once again reminded that we could only reach this point thanks to everyone’s support. I want to express my heartfelt gratitude!

We carefully read every comment shared through Steam reviews, community posts, and social media. While we are encouraged by the many voices enjoying the game, we have also received reports of bugs and localization issues. We are reviewing these now and preparing to address them as quickly as possible through patch updates.

Based on the issues pointed out in reviews and community posts, we have made urgent fixes today and released a patch that includes bug fixes and localization adjustments.

v1.0.1: Localization and Bug Fixes
＝＝＝
Fixes

Corrected parts of the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese localization.

Fixed an issue in CHAPTER 1-3 where the movie would not play.

Improved image quality and design of Steam achievement icons (Steam restart recommended).
＝＝＝

As for future updates:
We have received feedback that the English localization feels unnatural. In coordination with our publisher, we plan to review and revise the overall text, with a major update scheduled for the future.
In addition, we are investigating other improvement requests from players to see what can be addressed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/38892d8ce9a7c8864c9cb40a051112c3cd1851c7.png[/img]

Next week, I will personally be attending TGS and standing at our booth. I am very much looking forward to meeting you in person and talking about the game!

With all of your feedback in mind, we will continue to work hard to improve the game so that it can be enjoyed more comfortably and without stress.
Thank you again for your continued support of Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo!
